description:
Israel's Knesset speaker plays a key role in shaping the legislative agenda, overseeing parliamentary proceedings and managing the process of forming a government. With Matan Kahana elected speaker, Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc could move forward with legislation aimed at reversing major policies introduced under Benjamin Netanyahu's government. Its proposals include establishing an independent commission of inquiry into the October 7 attacks, restoring powers to the attorney general and reversing changes to the judiciary. The bloc is also considering legislation to impose a two-term limit on the prime minister's office, which would prevent Netanyahu from returning to the position if passed. Palestinian-Israeli parties have pledged support for the opposition's efforts, helping it secure a majority in the Knesset.
